translations.idiomatic: He is appointed Right Mentor of the Heir Apparent, to inherit the title Duke Wenxuan and restore his family.

sentences.zh: 」未幾，通判密州。

translations.literal: Not long after, he was appointed Deputy Prefect of Mizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Not long after, he was made deputy prefect of Mizhou.

sentences.zh: 太平興國八年，詔修曲阜孔子廟，宜貢方物為謝，詔褒之，遷殿中丞。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Taiping Xingguo, an edict ordered repairs to the Confucius Temple in Qufu; Yi offered local products in gratitude; an edict praised him, and he was promoted to Palace Aide.
translations.idiomatic: In Taiping Xingguo 8, an edict ordered repairs to the Confucius Temple in Qufu. Yi sent local products in thanks; the court praised him and promoted him to palace aide.

sentences.zh: 雍熙三年，王師北征，受詔督軍糧，涉拒馬河溺死，年四十六。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongxi, when the imperial army marched north, he received orders to supervise army grain; crossing the Juma River he drowned, aged forty-six.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongxi 3, when the imperial army marched north, he was ordered to supervise army grain. He drowned crossing the Juma River, aged forty-six.

sentences.zh: 子延世字茂先，以父死事，賜學究出身，為曲阜主簿，曆閩、長葛二令。

translations.literal: His son Yanshi, styled Maoxian, because his father died on duty, was granted the status of learned investigator, served as Registrar of Qufu, and was magistrate of Min and Changge.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yanshi, styled Maoxian, received learned-investigator status because his father died in service. He served as registrar of Qufu and as magistrate of Min and Changge.

sentences.zh: 真宗至道三年十一月，召赴闕，以為曲阜令，襲封文宣公，賜白金、束帛及太宗御書印《九經》。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the third year of Zhidao of Zhenzong he was summoned to court, appointed Magistrate of Qufu, inherited Duke Wenxuan, and was granted white gold, bolts of silk, and Taizong's hand-copied imprinted Nine Classics.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Zhidao 3 of Zhenzong he was summoned to court, made magistrate of Qufu, inherited the title Duke Wenxuan, and received white gold, bolts of silk, and Taizong's hand-copied imprinted Nine Classics.

sentences.zh: 咸平三年，詔本道轉運使、本州長吏待以賓禮，仍留三年，卒官，年三十八。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xianping, an edict ordered the circuit transport commissioner and prefectural officials to treat him with guest ceremony; he remained three years and died in office, aged thirty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianping 3, an edict directed the circuit transport commissioner and local officials to receive him with guest ceremony. He stayed three years and died in office, aged thirty-eight.

sentences.zh: 次曰憲，太平興國二年進士及第，至工部員外郎、知浚儀縣。

translations.literal: The next was Xian, who passed the jinshi in the second year of Taiping Xingguo, and rose to Vice Director of the Ministry of Works and Magistrate of Junyi County.
translations.idiomatic: The next son was Xian, who passed the jinshi in Taiping Xingguo 2 and rose to vice director in the Ministry of Works and magistrate of Junyi County.

sentences.zh: 次曰冕，應城主簿。

translations.literal: The next was Mian, Registrar of Yingcheng.
translations.idiomatic: The next was Mian, registrar of Yingcheng.

sentences.zh: 次曰勖，雍熙中進士及第。

translations.literal: The next was Xu, who passed the jinshi in the Yongxi era.
translations.idiomatic: The next was Xu, who passed the jinshi during the Yongxi era.

sentences.zh: 延世子聖祐，景德初，始九歲，特賜同學究出身。

translations.literal: Yanshi's son Shengyou, in the early Jingde era when he was only nine, was specially granted the status of learned investigator.
translations.idiomatic: Yanshi's son Shengyou was only nine in the early Jingde era when he was specially granted learned-investigator status.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符元年，東封泰山，特聽聖祐衣綠陪位，綴京官班後。

translations.literal: In the first year of Dazhong Xiangfu, when paying respects at Mount Tai, Shengyou was specially permitted to wear green robes and take place in attendance, following after the capital officials.
translations.idiomatic: In Dazhong Xiangfu 1, during the eastern tour and Mount Tai rites, Shengyou was specially allowed to wear green robes and take part in the ceremony, standing after the capital officials.

sentences.zh: 及還至兗州，十一月朔，幸曲阜，謁孔子廟，行酌獻之禮，孔氏宗屬並令倍位。

translations.literal: When returning to Yan Prefecture, on the first day of the eleventh month, [the emperor] visited Qufu, paid respects at the Confucius Temple, performed the libation-offering rite, and all Kong clansmen were ordered to double their places.
translations.idiomatic: On the return to Yan Prefecture, on the first day of the eleventh month, the emperor visited Qufu, paid respects at the Confucius Temple, and performed the libation offering. All members of the Kong clan were given doubled places of honor.

sentences.zh: 又幸孔林，觀其墓久之。

translations.literal: He also visited the Kong Grove and gazed long at the tomb.
translations.idiomatic: He also visited the Kong Grove and lingered long at the tomb.

sentences.zh: 又禦北亭，召從臣觀古碑，加諡孔子為玄聖文宣王，追封孔子父叔梁紇齊國公，母顏氏魯國太夫人。

translations.literal: He also proceeded to the North Pavilion, summoned attendant ministers to view ancient steles, added the posthumous title Mysterious Sage King Wenxuan to Confucius, posthumously enfeoffed Confucius's father Shuliang He as Duke of Qi, and his mother Lady Yan as Grand Lady of Lu.
translations.idiomatic: He then went to the North Pavilion and summoned his ministers to view ancient steles. He added the posthumous title Mysterious Sage King Wenxuan to Confucius, posthumously enfeoffed Confucius's father Shuliang He as Duke of Qi, and his mother Lady Yan as Grand Lady of Lu.

sentences.zh: 擢聖祐為太常寺奉禮郎，又錄其近屬進士謂同《三傳》出身，習進士延祐、習學究延渥、延魯、延齡並同學究出身，共賜銀二百兩、絹三百匹，以充奉祠廟。

translations.literal: Shengyou was promoted to Ritual Officer of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; his close kinsman the jinshi Wei was granted status equal to a Three Commentaries graduate; Yanyou, who was studying for the jinshi, and Yanwo, Yanlu, and Yanling, who were studying as learned investigators, were all granted learned investigator status; together they received two hundred taels of silver and three hundred bolts of silk for temple maintenance.
translations.idiomatic: Shengyou was promoted to ritual officer of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices. His close kinsman Wei, a jinshi, was granted status equal to a Three Commentaries graduate; Yanyou, who was preparing for the jinshi, and Yanwo, Yanlu, and Yanling, who were studying as learned investigators, were all granted learned-investigator status. Together they received two hundred taels of silver and three hundred bolts of silk for temple upkeep.

sentences.zh: 時勖為殿中丞、通判廣州，王欽若言其有聲於鄉曲，召赴闕，改太常博士，賜緋，令知曲阜縣，專主祠廟。

translations.literal: At the time Xu was Palace Aide and Deputy Prefect of Guangzhou; Wang Qinruo said he had reputation in his home district; summoned to court, he was changed to Doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, granted purple, and ordered to govern Qufu County specializing in temple affairs.
translations.idiomatic: At the time Xu was palace aide and deputy prefect of Guangzhou. Wang Qinruo said he was well regarded in his home district, and he was summoned to court, made doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, granted purple robes, and put in charge of Qufu County with sole responsibility for the temple.

sentences.zh: 二年三月，又遣使賜太宗御書及《九經》書疏、《三史》藏於廟，令本州選儒生講說。

translations.literal: In the third month of the second year, envoys were again dispatched to bestow Taizong's hand-copy, the Nine Classics with commentaries, and the Three Histories to be stored in the temple; the prefecture was ordered to select Confucian scholars to lecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the second year, envoys again brought Taizong's hand-copy, the Nine Classics with commentaries, and the Three Histories to be stored in the temple, and the prefecture was ordered to select Confucian scholars to lecture there.

sentences.zh: 聖祐後改大理評事。

translations.literal: Later Shengyou was changed to Case Reviewer of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: Shengyou was later made case reviewer of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 天禧五年，授光祿寺丞，襲封文宣公、知仙源縣事。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Tianxi, he was appointed Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, inherited Duke Wenxuan, and governed Xianyuan County.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianxi 5 he was appointed vice director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, inherited the title Duke Wenxuan, and governed Xianyuan County.

sentences.zh: 後改名佑，遷太子中舍，卒，年三十。

translations.literal: Later he changed his name to You, was promoted to Gentleman Attendant of the Heir Apparent, and died aged thirty.
translations.idiomatic: He later changed his name to You, was promoted to gentleman attendant of the heir apparent, and died aged thirty.

sentences.zh: 勖為司封郎中。

translations.literal: Xu became Director in the Department of Enfeoffments.
translations.idiomatic: Xu became director in the Department of Enfeoffments.

sentences.zh: 延魯，大中祥符五年復舉進士及第，後改名道輔，為左司諫、龍圖閣待制，自有傳。

translations.literal: Yanlu, in the fifth year of Dazhong Xiangfu again passed the jinshi, later changed his name to Daofu, served as Left Remonstrance and Hanlin academician of the Dragon Diagram Pavilion—has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: Yanlu passed the jinshi again in Dazhong Xiangfu 5, later changed his name to Daofu, and served as left remonstrance and Hanlin academician of the Dragon Diagram Pavilion; he has his own biography.

sentences.zh: 崔頌，字敦美，河南偃師人。

translations.literal: Cui Song, styled Dunmei, a native of Yanshi in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Song, styled Dunmei, was a native of Yanshi in Henan.

sentences.zh: 父協，後唐門下侍郎、平章事。

translations.literal: His father Xie was Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councilor of Later Tang.
translations.idiomatic: His father Xie had been vice director of the Secretariat and grand councilor under Later Tang.

sentences.zh: 頌幼喪母，為外祖母所鞠養。

translations.literal: Song lost his mother in childhood and was raised by his maternal grandmother.
translations.idiomatic: Song lost his mother as a child and was raised by his maternal grandmother.

sentences.zh: 以蔭補河南府巡官，曆開封主簿、鄧州錄事參軍，以疾去官。

translations.literal: Through yin privilege he was appointed patrol officer of Henan Prefecture, served as Registrar of Kaifeng and Judicial Secretary of Deng Prefecture, and left office due to illness.
translations.idiomatic: Through yin privilege he became patrol officer of Henan Prefecture, served as registrar of Kaifeng and judicial secretary of Deng Prefecture, and left office because of illness.

sentences.zh: 未幾，詣闕上書言事，宰相桑維翰覽而奇之，擢為左拾遺，選右補闕。

translations.literal: Not long after, he went to court with a written submission on affairs of state; Chief Minister Sang Weihan read it and found it remarkable, promoted him to Left Reminder, then selected Right Supplementer.
translations.idiomatic: Not long after, he went to court with a memorial on public affairs. Chief Minister Sang Weihan read it and was impressed, promoting him to left reminder and then selecting him as right supplementer.

sentences.zh: 漢初，加朝散階，副右散騎常侍張煦冊錢俶為吳越王。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Han, he was given the rank of Grand Master of Dispersal, and as deputy to Right Regular Attendant Zhang Xu enfeoffed Qian Chu as King of Wuyue.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Later Han dynasty he was given the rank of grand master of dispersal and, as deputy to Right Regular Attendant Zhang Xu, helped invest Qian Chu as King of Wuyue.

sentences.zh: 梁末，協嘗使兩浙，至是，越人美之，贈賄甚厚。

translations.literal: At the end of Liang, Xie had once been envoy to the Two Zhes; at this time the people of Yue praised this, and gifts were very generous.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Later Liang, Xie had once served as envoy to the Two Zhes; now the people of Yue honored that connection, and their gifts were very generous.

sentences.zh: 及還，值周祖入京師，為軍士剽奪悉盡。

translations.literal: On returning, Zhou Taizu entered the capital; [the gifts] were plundered entirely by soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On the return, Zhou Taizu entered the capital, and soldiers plundered everything.

sentences.zh: 世宗鎮澶淵，擇僚佐，頌與王樸、王敏中皆中其選，以頌為觀察判官，贈金紫。

translations.literal: When Shizong was stationed at Danyuan, he selected aides; Song, Wang Pu, and Wang Minzhong were all chosen; Song was made staff officer to the observation commissioner and granted gold seal and purple robe.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizong was stationed at Danyuan, he chose aides; Song, Wang Pu, and Wang Minzhong were all selected. Song was made staff officer to the observation commissioner and granted gold seal and purple robe.

sentences.zh: 世宗尹京，拜司封員外郎、充判官，以斷獄誤失罷職，守本官。

translations.literal: When Shizong governed the capital, he was appointed Vice Director in the Department of Enfeoffments and served as aide; due to errors in adjudicating cases he was dismissed from duty but retained his rank.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizong governed the capital, he was appointed vice director in the Department of Enfeoffments and served as aide. Because of errors in adjudicating cases he was removed from duty but kept his rank.

sentences.zh: 即位，拜駕部郎中，遷吏部，復副尹日就使兩浙。

translations.literal: Upon accession he was appointed Director of the Department of Transport, moved to the Ministry of Personnel, and again served as deputy to Yin Riqiu on mission to the Two Zhes.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizong took the throne, Song was appointed director of the Department of Transport, then moved to the Ministry of Personnel, and again served as deputy to Yin Riqiu on a mission to the Two Zhes.

sentences.zh: 世宗讀唐元稹《均田疏》，命寫為圖賜近臣，遣使均諸道租賦，頌使兗州，頗增舊額。

translations.literal: Shizong read Yuan Zhen's "Memorial on Equal Fields" of Tang, ordered it written as a chart and bestowed on near ministers, dispatched envoys to equalize rents and taxes in all circuits; Song went to Yan Prefecture and considerably increased the old quota.
translations.idiomatic: Shizong read Yuan Zhen's Tang memorial on equal fields, had it copied as a chart and given to close ministers, and sent envoys to equalize rents and taxes in every circuit. Song went to Yan Prefecture and raised the old quota considerably.

sentences.zh: 恭帝嗣位，改左諫議大夫。

translations.literal: When Gongdi succeeded, he was changed to Left Advisory Grand Master.
translations.idiomatic: When Gongdi succeeded to the throne, he was made left advisory grand master.

sentences.zh: 宋初，判國子監。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Song, he was given concurrent charge of the Directorate of Education.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Song dynasty he was put in charge of the Directorate of Education.

sentences.zh: 會重修國學及武成王廟，命頌總領其事。

translations.literal: When the Imperial Academy and the Temple of Military King were being rebuilt, Song was ordered to oversee the whole affair.
translations.idiomatic: When the Imperial Academy and the Temple of the Military King were being rebuilt, Song was ordered to oversee the work.

sentences.zh: 建隆三年夏，始會生徒講說，太祖遣中使以酒果賜之。

translations.literal: In the summer of the third year of Jianlong, students first assembled for lectures; Taizu sent palace envoys with wine and fruit as gifts.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of Jianlong 3, students first gathered for lectures, and Taizu sent palace envoys with wine and fruit as gifts.

sentences.zh: 每臨幸國學，召頌與語。

translations.literal: Each time he visited the Imperial Academy he summoned Song to converse.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever he visited the Imperial Academy, he summoned Song to talk with him.

sentences.zh: 因及經義，頌應答無滯。

translations.literal: When the conversation reached classical meaning, Song answered without hesitation.
translations.idiomatic: When the conversation turned to classical meaning, Song answered without hesitation.

sentences.zh: 及郊祀，以頌攝太僕，升車執綏，上問以一時典禮，頌占對閑雅，上甚重之。

translations.literal: At the suburban sacrifice, Song acted as Grand Master of Horse, mounting the carriage and holding the reins; the emperor questioned him on ritual of the occasion; Song answered at ease and elegantly; the emperor greatly valued him.
translations.idiomatic: At the suburban sacrifice, Song acted as grand master of horse, mounting the carriage and holding the reins. The emperor questioned him about the rites of the occasion, and Song answered with easy elegance. The emperor greatly valued him.

sentences.zh: 未幾，坐請托有司為所親求便官，出為保大軍行軍司馬。

translations.literal: Not long after, for soliciting officials on behalf of a close relative for a convenient post, he was demoted to Military Secretary of the Baoda Army.
translations.idiomatic: Not long after, because he had asked officials to give a close relative a convenient post, he was demoted to military secretary of the Baoda Army.

sentences.zh: 乾德六年，暴得疾卒，年五十。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Qiande he suddenly fell ill and died, aged fifty.
translations.idiomatic: In Qiande 6 he suddenly fell ill and died, aged fifty.

sentences.zh: 頌好詼諧，善筆劄，受命書世宗諡冊文，當時稱其遒麗。

translations.literal: Song loved humor, was skilled at letters; commissioned to write Shizong's posthumous title document, contemporaries praised its force and elegance.
translations.idiomatic: Song loved wit and was skilled at letters. Commissioned to write Shizong's posthumous title document, contemporaries praised its force and elegance.

sentences.zh: 篤信釋氏，睹佛像必拜。

translations.literal: He deeply believed in Buddhism; seeing a Buddha image he always bowed.
translations.idiomatic: He was a devout Buddhist and always bowed when he saw a Buddha image.

sentences.zh: 性多疑，在鄜州官舍，嘗召圬墁者治堂室，以帛蒙其目，人皆笑之。

translations.literal: He was suspicious by nature; at his official residence in Fu Prefecture he once summoned plasterers to repair the hall, covering their eyes with cloth; people all laughed at this.
translations.idiomatic: He was suspicious by nature. At his official residence in Fu Prefecture he once summoned plasterers to repair the hall and covered their eyes with cloth; everyone laughed at this.

sentences.zh: 子曉，至太子右讚善大夫。

translations.literal: His son Xiao reached Right Mentor of the Heir Apparent in the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: His son Xiao rose to right mentor of the heir apparent in the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 尹拙，潁州汝陰人。

translations.literal: Yin Zhuo, a native of Ruyin in Ying Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Zhuo was a native of Ruyin in Ying Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 梁貞明五年舉《三史》，調補下邑主簿，攝本鎮館驛巡官。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Zhenming of Liang he passed the Three Histories examination, was assigned as registrar of a minor county, and acted as patrol officer of the post station of the home garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhenming 5 of Later Liang he passed the Three Histories examination, was assigned as registrar of a minor county, and acted as patrol officer of his garrison's post station.

sentences.zh: 後唐長興中，召為著作佐郎、直史館，遷左拾遺，依前直史館，加朝散大夫。

translations.literal: In the Changxing era of Later Tang he was summoned as Assistant Drafting Official and historian on duty in the Historiography Institute, promoted to Left Reminder, continuing as historian on duty, granted Grand Master of Dispersal.
translations.idiomatic: In the Changxing era of Later Tang he was summoned as assistant drafting official and historian on duty in the Historiography Institute, promoted to left reminder while continuing as historian on duty, and granted the rank of grand master of dispersal.

sentences.zh: 應順初，出為宣武軍掌書記、檢校虞部員外郎兼殿中侍御史。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yingshun he went out as secretary of the Xuanwu Army, titular Vice Director in the Ministry of Public Works and concurrently Palace Investigator.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Yingshun he went out as secretary of the Xuanwu Army, with titular rank as vice director in the Ministry of Public Works and concurrent service as palace investigator.

sentences.zh: 清泰初，加檢校駕部員外郎兼御史大夫。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qingtai he was given titular Vice Director in the Ministry of Transport and concurrent Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Qingtai he was given titular rank as vice director in the Ministry of Transport and concurrent service as censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 二年，改檢校虞部郎中、忠武軍掌書記。

translations.literal: In the second year he was changed to titular Director in the Ministry of Public Works and secretary of the Zhongwu Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he was changed to titular director in the Ministry of Public Works and secretary of the Zhongwu Army.

sentences.zh: 晉天福四年，入為右補闕。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tianfu of Jin he entered [court] as Right Supplementer.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianfu 4 of Later Jin he entered court as right supplementer.

sentences.zh: 明年，轉侍御史。

translations.literal: The next year he was transferred to Attending Censor.
translations.idiomatic: The next year he was transferred to attending censor.

sentences.zh: 會詔拙與張昭、呂琦等同修《唐史》，改倉部員外郎，賜金紫。

translations.literal: When an edict ordered Zhuo together with Zhang Zhao, Lü Qi and others to compile the History of Tang, he was changed to Vice Director in the Ministry of Revenue and granted gold seal and purple robe.
translations.idiomatic: When an edict ordered Zhuo, together with Zhang Zhao, Lü Qi, and others, to compile the History of Tang, he was made vice director in the Ministry of Revenue and granted gold seal and purple robe.

sentences.zh: 八年，遷左司員外郎。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was promoted to Vice Director in the Left Department.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was promoted to vice director in the Left Department.

sentences.zh: 契丹入寇，趙延壽鎮常山。

translations.literal: The Khitans invaded; Zhao Yanshou was stationed at Changshan.
translations.idiomatic: When the Khitans invaded, Zhao Yanshou was stationed at Changshan.

sentences.zh: 以拙為掌書記。

translations.literal: Zhuo was made secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuo was made his secretary.

sentences.zh: 漢初，召為司馬郎中、弘文館直學士。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Han he was summoned as Director in the Ministry of War and academician on duty in the Hongwen Institute.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Later Han dynasty he was summoned as director in the Ministry of War and academician on duty in the Hongwen Institute.

sentences.zh: 周廣順初，遷庫部郎中兼太常博士，仍充直學士。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Guangshun of Zhou he was promoted to Director in the Ministry of Storage and concurrently Doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, still serving as academician on duty.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Guangshun under Later Zhou he was promoted to director in the Ministry of Storage and concurrently doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, while continuing as academician on duty.

sentences.zh: 奉使荊南還，改兵部郎中。

translations.literal: Returning from mission to Jingnan, he was changed to Director in the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: After returning from a mission to Jingnan, he was made director in the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 顯德初，拜檢校右散騎常侍、國子祭酒、通判太常禮院事，與張昭同修唐應順、清泰及周《祖實錄》，又與昭及田敏同詳定《經典釋文》。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xiande he was appointed titular Right Regular Attendant, Chancellor of the Imperial University, and concurrent administrator of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; with Zhang Zhao he compiled the Veritable Records of Yingshun and Qingtai of Tang and the Zhou Ancestor; and with Zhao and Tian Min he collated the Classic Glosses.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Xiande he was appointed titular right regular attendant, chancellor of the Imperial University, and concurrent administrator of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices. With Zhang Zhao he compiled the veritable records of Yingshun and Qingtai of Tang and the Zhou Ancestor; with Zhao and Tian Min he collated the Classic Glosses.

sentences.zh: 丁憂，免。

translations.literal: Upon mourning for a parent, he was released [from office].
translations.idiomatic: When his mourning period began, he was released from office.

sentences.zh: 宋初，改檢校工部尚書、太子詹事、判太府寺，遷秘書監、判大理寺。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Song he was changed to titular Minister of Works, Grand Tutor of the Heir Apparent, and concurrent administrator of the Court of the Imperial Treasury; he moved to Director of the Imperial Archives and concurrent administrator of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Song dynasty he was made titular minister of works, grand tutor of the heir apparent, and concurrent administrator of the Court of the Imperial Treasury, then moved to director of the Imperial Archives and concurrent administrator of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 乾德六年告老，以本官致事。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Qiande he announced his old age and retired with his existing rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Qiande 6 he announced his retirement and left office with his existing rank.

sentences.zh: 拙性純謹，博通經史。

translations.literal: Zhuo was plain and careful by nature, thoroughly versed in the classics and histories.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuo was plain and careful by nature and thoroughly versed in the classics and histories.

sentences.zh: 周世宗北征，命翰林學士為文祭白馬祠，學士不知所出，遂訪於拙，拙曆舉郡國祠白馬者以十數，當時伏其該博。

translations.literal: When Zhou Shizong marched north, he ordered Hanlin academicians to compose a text to sacrifice at the White Horse Shrine; the academicians did not know the source and therefore consulted Zhuo; Zhuo enumerated in succession a dozen or so prefectures and principalities that had White Horse shrines; contemporaries admired his comprehensive learning.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhou Shizong marched north, he ordered Hanlin academicians to compose a sacrifice text for the White Horse Shrine. The academicians did not know the source and consulted Zhuo, who listed in succession more than a dozen prefectures and principalities with White Horse shrines. Contemporaries admired his breadth of learning.

sentences.zh: 開寶四年卒，年八十一。

translations.literal: He died in the fourth year of Kaibao, aged eighty-one.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Kaibao 4, aged eighty-one.

sentences.zh: 子季通，至國子博士。

translations.literal: His son Jitong reached Doctor of the Imperial University.
translations.idiomatic: His son Jitong rose to doctor of the Imperial University.

sentences.zh: 田敏，淄州鄒平人。

translations.literal: Tian Min, a native of Zouping in Zi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Min was a native of Zouping in Zi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 少通《春秋》之學。

translations.literal: In youth he mastered the study of the Spring and Autumn Annals.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he mastered the Spring and Autumn Annals.

sentences.zh: 梁貞明中登科，調補淄州主簿，不令之任，留為國子四門博士。

translations.literal: In the Zhenming era of Liang he passed the examination, was assigned as registrar of Zi Prefecture, but was not ordered to take up the post—kept as Doctor of the Four Gates at the Imperial University.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhenming era of Later Liang he passed the examination and was assigned as registrar of Zi Prefecture, but was not sent to take up the post and was kept instead as a Four Gates doctor at the Imperial University.

sentences.zh: 後唐天成初，改《尚書》博士，賜緋。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tiancheng of Later Tang he was changed to Doctor of the Book of Documents and granted purple.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Tiancheng under Later Tang he was made doctor of the Book of Documents and granted purple robes.

sentences.zh: 滿歲，為國子博士。

translations.literal: When his term was complete, he became Doctor of the Imperial University.
translations.idiomatic: When his term was complete, he became doctor of the Imperial University.

sentences.zh: 上言請四郊置齋宮，不報。

translations.literal: He submitted a memorial requesting ritual halls at the four suburban [sacrificial sites]; no response.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a memorial requesting ritual halls at the four suburban sacrificial sites, but received no response.

sentences.zh: 秩滿，轉屯田員外郎，以詳明典禮兼太常博士。

translations.literal: When his rank term ended, he was transferred to Vice Director in the Ministry of Public Works for state lands, and because of his expertise in rites was concurrently Doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: When his term of office ended, he was transferred to vice director in the state-lands bureau and, because of his expertise in rites, was concurrently made doctor of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 建議請依《春秋》每歲藏冰薦宗廟，頒公卿，如古禮。

translations.literal: He proposed that according to the Spring and Autumn Annals, each year stored ice be presented at the ancestral temple and distributed to dukes and ministers, as in ancient rites.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed that, following the Spring and Autumn Annals, stored ice be presented each year at the ancestral temple and distributed to dukes and ministers, as in ancient rites.

sentences.zh: 奉詔與太常卿劉嶽、博士段顒、路航、李居浣、陳觀等刪定唐鄭餘慶《書儀》，又詔與馬鎬等同校《九經》。

translations.literal: By imperial order he joined Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Liu Yue, Doctors Duan Yong, Lu Hang, Li Juhuan, Chen Guan and others in revising Zheng Yuqing's Book of Ritual Forms of Tang; again ordered with Ma Gao and others to collate the Nine Classics.
translations.idiomatic: By imperial order he joined Court of Imperial Sacrifices director Liu Yue and doctors Duan Yong, Lu Hang, Li Juhuan, Chen Guan, and others in revising Zheng Yuqing's Book of Ritual Forms of Tang, and was again ordered with Ma Gao and others to collate the Nine Classics.

sentences.zh: 改戶部員外郎，賜金紫。

translations.literal: He was changed to Vice Director in the Ministry of Revenue and granted gold seal and purple robe.
translations.idiomatic: He was made vice director in the Ministry of Revenue and granted gold seal and purple robe.

sentences.zh: 清泰初，遷國子司業。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qingtai he was transferred to Vice Chancellor of the Imperial University.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Qingtai he was transferred to vice chancellor of the Imperial University.

sentences.zh: 晉天福四年授祭酒，仍檢校工部尚書，俄兼戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tianfu of Jin he was appointed Chancellor of the Imperial University, still holding the titular post of Minister of Works, and soon was concurrently Vice Director in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianfu 4 under Later Jin he was appointed chancellor of the Imperial University, while retaining his titular post as minister of works, and soon was also made vice director in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 開運初，遷兵部侍郎，充弘文館學士、判館事。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kaiyun he was promoted to Vice Director in the Ministry of War, serving as academician of the Hongwen Institute and administrator of the institute.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Kaiyun he was promoted to vice director in the Ministry of War and served as academician of the Hongwen Institute and administrator of the institute.

sentences.zh: 議者以敏止可任學官，宰相桑維翰聞之，即改授檢校右僕射，復為祭酒。

translations.literal: Commentators held that Min was only fit to serve as an academic official; when Grand Councillor Sang Weihan heard this, he immediately changed the appointment to titular Right Vice Director and restored him as Chancellor of the Imperial University.
translations.idiomatic: Commentators held that Min was fit only for an academic post; when Grand Councillor Sang Weihan heard this, he immediately changed the appointment to titular right vice director and restored him as chancellor of the Imperial University.

sentences.zh: 漢乾祐中，拜尚書右丞，判國子監。

translations.literal: During Gan.you of Han he was appointed Right Vice Director of the Ministry of State and concurrent administrator of the Directorate of the Imperial University.
translations.idiomatic: During Gan.you under Later Han he was appointed right vice director of the Ministry of State and concurrent administrator of the Directorate of the Imperial University.

sentences.zh: 周廣順初，改左丞，遣使契丹，將歲賂錢十萬貫，止其侵剽，契丹不許。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Guangshun of Zhou he was changed to Left Vice Director; sent as envoy to the Khitan, carrying one hundred thousand strings of annual tribute money to stop their raids and plunder—the Khitan did not agree.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Guangshun under Later Zhou he was made left vice director and sent as envoy to the Khitan with one hundred thousand strings of annual tribute money to stop their raids and plunder, but the Khitan refused.

sentences.zh: 周祖將親郊，命權判太常卿事。

translations.literal: When the Zhou Ancestor was about to perform the suburban sacrifice in person, he was ordered to serve provisionally as administrator of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: When the Zhou Ancestor was about to perform the suburban sacrifice in person, he was ordered to serve provisionally as administrator of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 世宗即位，真拜太常卿、檢校左僕射，加司空。

translations.literal: When Shizong took the throne, he was formally appointed Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and titular Left Vice Director, with the added title of Grand Master of Works.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizong took the throne, he was formally appointed director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and titular left vice director, with the added title of grand master of works.

sentences.zh: 顯德五年，上章請老，賜詔曰：「卿詳明禮樂，博涉典墳，為儒學之宗師，乃薦紳之儀表。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xiande he submitted a memorial requesting retirement; an edict was granted saying: "You are thorough and clear in rites and music, broadly versed in canonical works, a patriarch of Confucian learning and a model for the gentry."
translations.idiomatic: In Xiande 5 he submitted a memorial requesting retirement, and an edict was granted saying: "You are thorough and clear in rites and music, broadly versed in canonical works, a patriarch of Confucian learning and a model for the gentry."

sentences.zh: 朕方資舊德，以訪話言，遽覽封章，願致官政。

translations.literal: "We are just now relying on your established virtue to seek your counsels; suddenly reviewing your sealed memorial, you wish to relinquish official duties."
translations.idiomatic: "We are just now relying on your established virtue to seek your counsel; yet upon reading your sealed memorial, you wish to relinquish official duties."

sentences.zh: 引年之制難著舊文，尊賢之心方深虛佇，所請宜不允。

translations.literal: "The institution of citing one's years for retirement is hard to find in old texts; our heart of honoring the worthy is deeply set on awaiting you—the request should not be granted."
translations.idiomatic: "The institution of citing one's years for retirement is hard to find in old texts, and our heart of honoring the worthy is deeply set on awaiting you—your request should not be granted."

sentences.zh: 」遷工部尚書。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to minister of works.

sentences.zh: 俄再上表願歸故鄉，以遂首丘之志，改太子少保致仕，歸淄州別墅。

translations.literal: Soon he again submitted a memorial wishing to return to his native place to fulfill his wish to end his days at home; he was changed to Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent and retired, returning to his villa in Zi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he again submitted a memorial wishing to return home to fulfill his wish to end his days there; he was made junior mentor of the heir apparent and retired, returning to his villa in Zi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 恭帝即位，加少傅。

translations.literal: When Emperor Gong took the throne, he was given the added title of Junior Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Gong took the throne, he was given the added title of junior tutor.

sentences.zh: 開寶四年，卒，年九十二。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Kaibao he died, aged ninety-two.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Kaibao 4, aged ninety-two.

sentences.zh: 敏解官歸鄉，有良田數十頃，多釀美酒待賓客。

translations.literal: After Min left office and returned home, he had several dozen qing of good farmland and brewed much fine wine to receive guests.
translations.idiomatic: After Min left office and returned home, he had several dozen qing of good farmland and brewed much fine wine to receive guests.

sentences.zh: 體強少疾，徒步往來閭巷間，不以杖。

translations.literal: His body was strong and he had few illnesses; he walked back and forth through the lanes without using a staff.
translations.idiomatic: His body was strong and he had few illnesses; he walked back and forth through the lanes without using a staff.

sentences.zh: 每日親授諸子經。

translations.literal: Every day he personally instructed his sons in the classics.
translations.idiomatic: Every day he personally instructed his sons in the classics.

sentences.zh: 自作父墓碑，辭甚質。

translations.literal: He himself composed the tomb inscription for his father; the wording was very plain.
translations.idiomatic: He himself composed the tomb inscription for his father; the wording was very plain.

sentences.zh: 敏嘗使湖南，路出荊渚，以印本經書遺高從誨，從誨謝曰：「祭酒所遺經書，仆但能識《孝經》耳。

translations.literal: Min once served as envoy to Hunan, passing through Jingzhou on the way, and presented printed copies of the classics to Gao Conghui; Conghui declined saying: "The classics that the Chancellor has gifted—I, your servant, can only recognize the Classic of Filial Piety."
translations.idiomatic: Min once served as envoy to Hunan and, passing through Jingzhou on the way, presented printed copies of the classics to Gao Conghui. Conghui declined, saying: "The classics that the chancellor has gifted—I, your servant, can recognize only the Classic of Filial Piety."

sentences.zh: 」敏曰：「讀書不必多，十八章足矣。

translations.literal: Min said: "In reading books one need not read many—eighteen chapters suffice."
translations.idiomatic: Min said: "In reading books one need not read many—eighteen chapters suffice."

sentences.zh: 如《諸侯章》云『在上不驕，高而不危，製節謹度，滿而不溢』，皆至要之言也。

translations.literal: "Such as the chapter on feudal lords says, 'When in high position, do not be arrogant; though elevated, one is not endangered; regulate conduct and carefully observe measure; though full, one does not overflow'—all are words of supreme importance."
translations.idiomatic: "As the chapter on feudal lords says, 'When in high position, do not be arrogant; though elevated, one is not endangered; regulate conduct and carefully observe measure; though full, one does not overflow'—all are words of supreme importance."

sentences.zh: 」時從誨兵敗於郢，故敏以此諷之，從誨大慚。

translations.literal: At that time Conghui had been defeated in battle at Ying, so Min used this to admonish him indirectly, and Conghui was greatly ashamed.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Conghui had been defeated in battle at Ying, so Min used this to admonish him indirectly, and Conghui was greatly ashamed.

sentences.zh: 敏雖篤於經學，亦好為穿鑿，所校《九經》，頗以獨見自任，如改《尚書·盤庚》「若網在綱」為「若綱在綱」，重言「綱」字。

translations.literal: Although Min was devoted to classical learning, he also liked forced interpretations; in the Nine Classics he collated, he rather took pride in individual views—such as changing in the Pangeng chapter of the Book of Documents "as the net [has] a cord" to "as the cord [has] the net," repeating the word "cord."
translations.idiomatic: Although Min was devoted to classical learning, he also liked forced interpretations; in the Nine Classics he collated, he rather took pride in individual views—such as changing in the Pangeng chapter of the Book of Documents "as the net has a cord" to "as the cord has the net," repeating the word "cord."

sentences.zh: 又《爾雅》「椴，木槿」注曰：「日及」，改為「白及」。

translations.literal: Again, in the Erya "tuan, hibiscus" the annotation reads "ri ji," which he changed to "bai ji."
translations.idiomatic: Again, in the Erya entry "tuan, hibiscus," the annotation reads "ri ji," which he changed to "bai ji."

sentences.zh: 如此之類甚眾，世頗非之。

translations.literal: Cases of this sort were very numerous, and the age largely criticized him.
translations.idiomatic: Cases of this sort were very numerous, and the age largely criticized him.

sentences.zh: 子章，至殿中丞。

translations.literal: His son Zhang reached Palace Director.
translations.idiomatic: His son Zhang rose to palace director.

sentences.zh: 辛文悅

translations.literal: Xin Wenyue
translations.idiomatic: Xin Wenyue

sentences.zh: 辛文悅者，不知何許人。

translations.literal: Xin Wenyue—of what place he was from is unknown.
translations.idiomatic: Xin Wenyue was a man of unknown origin.

sentences.zh: 以《五經》教授，太祖幼時從其肄業。

translations.literal: He taught the Five Classics; in his youth the Taizu studied under him.
translations.idiomatic: He taught the Five Classics, and in his youth the Taizu studied under him.

sentences.zh: 周顯德中，太祖曆禁衛為殿前都點檢，節制方面。

translations.literal: During Xiande of Zhou the Taizu rose through the palace guards to become chief inspector of the Vanguard Army and governed a frontier region.
translations.idiomatic: During Xiande under Later Zhou the Taizu rose through the palace guards to become chief inspector of the Vanguard Army and governed a frontier region.

sentences.zh: 文悅久不獲接見，一日，夢邀車駕請見，既拜，乃太祖也。

translations.literal: Wenyue had long been unable to obtain an audience; one day he dreamed of inviting the imperial carriage to request an audience, and when he bowed, it was the Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: Wenyue had long been unable to obtain an audience; one day he dreamed of inviting the imperial carriage to request an audience, and when he bowed, it was the Taizu.

sentences.zh: 太祖亦夢其來謁，因令左右尋訪，文悅果自至，太祖異之。

translations.literal: The Taizu also dreamed of his coming to call; he therefore ordered attendants to seek him out, and Wenyue indeed came on his own—the Taizu marveled at this.
translations.idiomatic: The Taizu also dreamed of his coming to call, so he ordered attendants to seek him out; Wenyue indeed came on his own, and the Taizu marveled at this.

sentences.zh: 及登位，召見，授太子中允，判太府事。

translations.literal: When he ascended the throne, he summoned him for an audience, appointed him vice director in the Heir Apparent's household, and assigned him to administer the Court of the Imperial Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: When he ascended the throne, he summoned him for an audience, appointed him vice director in the heir apparent's household, and assigned him to administer the Court of the Imperial Treasury.

sentences.zh: 開寶三年，出知房州。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kaibao he was sent out as prefect of Fang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaibao 3 he was sent out as prefect of Fang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 時周鄭王出居是州，上以文悅長者，故命焉。

translations.literal: At that time the Prince of Zheng of Zhou was living in exile in that prefecture; the Emperor, because Wenyue was a man of mature years, therefore appointed him there.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Prince of Zheng of Zhou was living in exile in that prefecture; because Wenyue was a man of mature years, the emperor therefore appointed him there.

sentences.zh: 文悅後累遷至員外郎。

translations.literal: Wenyue later was promoted cumulatively to vice director.
translations.idiomatic: Wenyue later rose cumulatively to vice director.

sentences.zh: 又有張遁、張文旦者，嘗與太宗同學校，太平興國中，詣闕自言，各起家為主簿。

translations.literal: There were also Zhang Dun and Zhang Wendan, who had once studied at the same school as the Taizong; in Taiping Xingguo they came to court on their own account and each began his career as registrar.
translations.idiomatic: There were also Zhang Dun and Zhang Wendan, who had once studied at the same school as the Taizong; during Taiping Xingguo they came to court on their own account and each began his career as registrar.

sentences.zh: 李覺，字仲明，本京兆長安人。

translations.literal: Li Jue, styled Zhongming, was originally a man of Chang'an in Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jue, styled Zhongming, was originally from Chang'an in Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 曾祖鼎，唐國子祭酒、蘇州刺史，唐末避亂，徙家青州益都。

translations.literal: His great-grandfather Ding was Chancellor of the Imperial University and prefect of Su under Tang; at the end of Tang he fled the turmoil and moved his family to Yidu in Qing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: His great-grandfather Ding was chancellor of the Imperial University and prefect of Su under Tang; at the end of Tang he fled the turmoil and moved his family to Yidu in Qing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 鼎生瑜，本州推官。

translations.literal: Ding's son was Yu, investigating officer of that prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Ding's son was Yu, investigating officer of that prefecture.

sentences.zh: 瑜生成，字咸熙，性曠蕩，嗜酒，喜吟詩，善琴奕，畫山水尤工，人多傳秘其跡。

translations.literal: Yu's son was Cheng, styled Xianxi—unrestrained by nature, fond of wine, delighted in composing poetry, skilled at zithers and go; he was especially adept at landscape painting, and many people secretly circulated his works.
translations.idiomatic: Yu's son was Cheng, styled Xianxi—unrestrained by nature, fond of wine, and delighted in composing poetry; he was skilled at zithers and go and especially adept at landscape painting, and many people secretly circulated his works.

sentences.zh: 周樞密使王樸將薦其能，會樸卒，鬱鬱不得志。

translations.literal: Zhou's commissioner of military affairs Wang Pu was about to recommend his talent, but Pu happened to die, and Cheng was depressed and unfulfilled.
translations.idiomatic: Later Zhou's commissioner of military affairs Wang Pu was about to recommend his talent, but Pu died, and Cheng was depressed and unfulfilled.

sentences.zh: 乾德中，司農卿衛融知陳州，聞其名，召之，成因挈族而往，日以酣飲為事，醉死於客舍。

translations.literal: During Qiande, Director of the Directorate of Agriculture Wei Rong was administering Chen Prefecture; hearing his name, he summoned him; Cheng took his clan and went, making daily drunken revelry his occupation, and died drunk at a guest house.
translations.idiomatic: During Qiande, Director of the Directorate of Agriculture Wei Rong was administering Chen Prefecture; hearing his name, he summoned him. Cheng took his clan and went, making daily drunken revelry his occupation, and died drunk at a guest house.

sentences.zh: 子覺，太平興國五年舉《九經》，起家將作監丞、通判建州，秩將滿，州人借留，有詔褒之，就遷左讚善大夫、知泗州，轉秘書丞。

translations.literal: His son Jue, in the fifth year of Taiping Xingguo, passed the examination in the Nine Classics and began his career as vice director in the Directorate of Public Works and military administrator of Jian Prefecture; when his term was nearly complete, the people of the prefecture petitioned to retain him; an edict commended him, and he was promoted on the spot to Left Supporter of Goodness and prefect of Si Prefecture, then transferred to secretary.
translations.idiomatic: His son Jue passed the examination in the Nine Classics in Taiping Xingguo 5 and began his career as vice director in the Directorate of Public Works and military administrator of Jian Prefecture. When his term was nearly complete, the people of the prefecture petitioned to retain him; an edict commended him, and he was promoted on the spot to left supporter of goodness and prefect of Si Prefecture, then transferred to secretary.

sentences.zh: 太宗以孔穎達《五經正義》刊板詔孔維與覺等校定。

translations.literal: The Taizong ordered Kong Wei together with Jue and others to collate and fix the block-printed Five Classics with Correct Meaning by Kong Yingda.
translations.idiomatic: The Taizong ordered Kong Wei together with Jue and others to collate and fix the block-printed Five Classics with Correct Meaning by Kong Yingda.

sentences.zh: 王師征燕、薊，命覺部京東諸州芻糧赴幽州。

translations.literal: When the imperial army campaigned against Yan and Ji, Jue was ordered to marshal fodder and grain from the eastern capital circuits to Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: When the imperial army campaigned against Yan and Ji, Jue was ordered to marshal fodder and grain from the eastern capital circuits to Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 維薦覺有學，遷《禮記》博士，賜緋魚。

translations.literal: Wei recommended Jue for his learning; he was promoted to doctor of the Book of Rites and granted purple and fish insignia.
translations.idiomatic: Wei recommended Jue for his learning; he was promoted to doctor of the Book of Rites and granted purple robes and fish insignia.

sentences.zh: 雍熙三年，與右補闕李若拙同使交州，黎桓謂曰：「此土山川之險，中朝人乍曆之，豈不倦乎？

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongxi, together with Right Remonstrance Officer Li Ruozhuo he served as envoy to Jiaozhi; Le Huan said to him: "The mountains and rivers of this land are treacherous—would not a man of the central court, suddenly traversing them, grow weary?"
translations.idiomatic: In Yongxi 3, together with right remonstrance officer Li Ruozhuo he served as envoy to Jiaozhi. Le Huan said to him: "The mountains and rivers of this land are treacherous—would not a man of the central court, suddenly traversing them, grow weary?"

sentences.zh: 」覺曰：「國家提封萬里，列郡四百，地有平易，亦有險固，此一方何足雲哉！

translations.literal: Jue said: "Our state extends its bounds for ten thousand li, with four hundred ranked prefectures; the land has level stretches and also perilous strongholds—what is this one region worth mentioning!"
translations.idiomatic: Jue said: "Our state extends its bounds for ten thousand li, with four hundred ranked prefectures; the land has level stretches and also perilous strongholds—what is this one region worth mentioning!"

sentences.zh: 」桓默然色沮。

translations.literal: Huan fell silent, his countenance deflated.
translations.idiomatic: Huan fell silent, his countenance deflated.

sentences.zh: 使還，久之，遷國子博士。

translations.literal: Returning from the mission, after a long while he was promoted to doctor of the Imperial University.
translations.idiomatic: After returning from the mission, he was promoted after a long interval to doctor of the Imperial University.

sentences.zh: 端拱元年春，初令學官講說，覺首預焉。

translations.literal: In spring of the first year of Duangong, when academic officials were first ordered to lecture and expound, Jue was first among those who participated.
translations.idiomatic: In spring of Duangong 1, when academic officials were first ordered to lecture and expound, Jue was first among those who participated.

sentences.zh: 太宗幸國子監謁文宣王畢，升輦將出西門，顧見講坐，左右言覺方聚徒講書，上即召覺，令對禦講。

translations.literal: When the Taizong visited the Directorate of the Imperial University to pay homage to the Sage King and, having finished, mounted his carriage about to exit the west gate, he looked back and saw the lecture hall; attendants said Jue was just then gathering disciples to lecture; the Emperor immediately summoned Jue and ordered him to lecture before the throne.
translations.idiomatic: When the Taizong visited the Directorate of the Imperial University to pay homage to the Sage King and, having finished, mounted his carriage about to exit the west gate, he looked back and saw the lecture hall. Attendants said Jue was just then gathering disciples to lecture; the emperor immediately summoned Jue and ordered him to lecture before the throne.

sentences.zh: 覺曰：「陛下六龍在禦，臣何敢輒升高坐。

translations.literal: Jue said: "Your Majesty's six dragons are present at the throne—how dare your servant presumptuously ascend the high seat."
translations.idiomatic: Jue said: "Your Majesty's six dragons are present at the throne—how dare I presumptuously ascend the high seat."

sentences.zh: 」上因降輦，令有司張帟幕，設別坐，詔覺講《周易》之《泰卦》，從臣皆列坐。

translations.literal: The Emperor therefore descended from his carriage, ordered the offices to hang curtains, set out a separate seat, and commanded Jue to expound the Tai hexagram of the Book of Changes; the attending ministers all took their seats in rows.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor therefore descended from his carriage, ordered the offices to hang curtains and set out a separate seat, and commanded Jue to expound the Tai hexagram of the Book of Changes; the attending ministers all took their seats in rows.

sentences.zh: 覺因述天地感通、君臣相應之旨，上甚悅，特賜帛百匹。

translations.literal: Jue thereupon expounded the purport of the resonance between Heaven and Earth and the correspondence between ruler and minister; the Emperor was greatly pleased and specially granted him one hundred bolts of silk.
translations.idiomatic: Jue thereupon expounded the purport of the resonance between Heaven and Earth and the correspondence between ruler and minister; the emperor was greatly pleased and specially granted him one hundred bolts of silk.

sentences.zh: 俄獻時務策，上頗嘉獎。

translations.literal: Soon he submitted a policy memorial on current affairs; the Emperor greatly commended it.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he submitted a policy memorial on current affairs, and the emperor greatly commended it.

sentences.zh: 是冬，以本官直史館。

translations.literal: That winter, with his existing rank he served on duty at the Historiography Institute.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, with his existing rank he served on duty at the Historiography Institute.

sentences.zh: 右正言王禹偁上言：「覺但能通經，不當輒居史職。

translations.literal: Right Rectifier Wang Yucheng submitted a memorial saying: "Jue can only expound the classics—he should not presumptuously hold a historiographical post."
translations.idiomatic: Right rectifier Wang Yucheng submitted a memorial saying: "Jue can only expound the classics—he should not presumptuously hold a historiographical post."

sentences.zh: 」覺仿韓愈《毛穎傳》作《竹穎傳》以獻，太宗嘉之，故寢禹偁之奏。

translations.literal: Jue, imitating Han Yu's Biography of Mao Ying, composed the Biography of Zhu Ying and presented it; the Taizong commended it, and therefore shelved Yucheng's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Jue, imitating Han Yu's Biography of Mao Ying, composed the Biography of Zhu Ying and presented it; the Taizong commended it, and therefore shelved Yucheng's memorial.

sentences.zh: 淳化初，上以經書板本有田敏輒刪去者數字，命覺與孔維詳定。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chunhua, because in the block-printed editions of the classics Tian Min had presumptuously deleted several characters, the Emperor ordered Jue and Kong Wei to examine and fix them in detail.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Chunhua, because in the block-printed editions of the classics Tian Min had presumptuously deleted several characters, the emperor ordered Jue and Kong Wei to examine and fix them in detail.

sentences.zh: 二年，詳校《春秋正義》成，改水部員外郎、判國子監。

translations.literal: In the second year, detailed collation of the Correct Meaning of the Spring and Autumn Annals was completed; he was changed to Vice Director in the Ministry of Works for waterworks and concurrent administrator of the Directorate of the Imperial University.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunhua 2, detailed collation of the Correct Meaning of the Spring and Autumn Annals was completed; he was made vice director in the waterworks bureau and concurrent administrator of the Directorate of the Imperial University.

sentences.zh: 四年，遷司門員外郎，被病。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was promoted to Vice Director in the Ministry of Justice for gatekeeping and fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunhua 4 he was promoted to vice director in the gatekeeping bureau and fell ill.

sentences.zh: 假滿，詔不絕奉，卒。

translations.literal: When his leave expired, an edict ordered that his salary not be cut off; he died.
translations.idiomatic: When his leave expired, an edict ordered that his salary not be cut off; he died.

sentences.zh: 覺累上書言時務，述養馬、漕運、屯田三事，太宗嘉其詳備，令送史館，語見本誌。

translations.literal: Jue repeatedly submitted memorials on current affairs, setting forth three matters—horse breeding, canal transport, and state lands; the Taizong commended their thoroughness and ordered them sent to the Historiography Institute; the wording appears in his basic record.
translations.idiomatic: Jue repeatedly submitted memorials on current affairs, setting forth three matters—horse breeding, canal transport, and state lands; the Taizong commended their thoroughness and ordered them sent to the Historiography Institute; the wording appears in his basic record.

sentences.zh: 覺性強毅而聰敏，嘗與秘閣校理吳淑等同考試開封府秋賦舉人，語及算雉兔首足法，覺曰：「此頗繁，吾能易之。

translations.literal: Jue was strong-willed and intelligent by nature; once, together with collator of the Secret Archive Wu Shu and others, he examined candidates in the autumn examination of Kaifeng Prefecture; when talk turned to the method of calculating pheasant and hare heads and feet, Jue said: "This is rather cumbersome—I can simplify it."
translations.idiomatic: Jue was strong-willed and intelligent by nature. Once, together with collator of the Secret Archive Wu Shu and others, he examined candidates in the autumn examination of Kaifeng Prefecture; when talk turned to the method of calculating pheasant and hare heads and feet, Jue said: "This is rather cumbersome—I can simplify it."

sentences.zh: 」及成，果精簡。

translations.literal: When it was finished, it was indeed concise.
translations.idiomatic: When it was finished, it was indeed concise.

sentences.zh: 淑意其宿製，即試以別法，皆能立就，坐中皆歎伏。

translations.literal: Shu suspected he had prepared it beforehand and immediately tested him with another method; he could complete each on the spot, and all present sighed in admiration.
translations.idiomatic: Shu suspected he had prepared it beforehand and immediately tested him with another method; he could complete each on the spot, and all present sighed in admiration.

sentences.zh: 子宥，大中祥符五年進士，為祠部員外郎、集賢校理。

translations.literal: His son You passed the jinshi examination in the fifth year of Dazhong Xiangfu and served as Vice Director in the Ministry of Rites for ancestral temples and collator of the Collection of Worthies.
translations.idiomatic: His son You passed the jinshi examination in Dazhong Xiangfu 5 and served as vice director in the ancestral-temples bureau and collator of the Collection of Worthies.

sentences.zh: 崔頤正

translations.literal: Cui Yizheng
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yizheng

sentences.zh: 崔頤正，開封封丘人。

translations.literal: Cui Yizheng was a man of Fengqiu in Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yizheng was from Fengqiu in Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 與弟偓佺並舉進士，明經術。

translations.literal: Together with his younger brother Woquan he passed the jinshi examination and was versed in the classics.
translations.idiomatic: Together with his younger brother Woquan he passed the jinshi examination and was versed in the classics.

sentences.zh: 頤正雍熙中為高密尉，秩滿，國子祭酒孔維薦之，以為國學直講，遷殿中丞。

translations.literal: Yizheng during Yongxi served as assistant magistrate of Gaomi; when his term ended, Chancellor of the Imperial University Kong Wei recommended him and he was made lecturer on duty at the National University, then promoted to Palace Director.
translations.idiomatic: During Yongxi Yizheng served as assistant magistrate of Gaomi; when his term ended, chancellor of the Imperial University Kong Wei recommended him, and he was made lecturer on duty at the National University, then promoted to palace director.

sentences.zh: 太宗召見，令說《莊子》一篇，賜錢五萬。

translations.literal: The Taizong summoned him for an audience, ordered him to expound one chapter of the Zhuangzi, and granted him fifty thousand cash.
translations.idiomatic: The Taizong summoned him for an audience, ordered him to expound one chapter of the Zhuangzi, and granted him fifty thousand cash.

sentences.zh: 判監李至上言：「本監先校定諸經音疏，其間文字訛謬尚多，深慮未副仁君好古誨人之意也。

translations.literal: Concurrent administrator Li Zhi submitted a memorial saying: "This directorate earlier collated the phonological commentaries of the various classics, yet among them erroneous and mistaken characters are still numerous; I deeply fear this has not fulfilled the benevolent ruler's intent to cherish antiquity and instruct the people."
translations.idiomatic: Concurrent administrator Li Zhi submitted a memorial saying: "This directorate earlier collated the phonological commentaries of the various classics, yet erroneous and mistaken characters are still numerous among them; I deeply fear this has not fulfilled the benevolent ruler's intent to cherish antiquity and instruct the people."

sentences.zh: 蓋前所遣官多專經之士，或通《春秋》者未習《禮記》，或習《周易》者不通《尚書》，至於旁引經史，皆非素所傳習，以是之故，未得周詳。

translations.literal: This is because the officials previously dispatched were mostly specialists in single classics—some versed in the Spring and Autumn Annals had not studied the Book of Rites, some versed in the Book of Changes did not understand the Book of Documents; as for citing other classics and histories in passing, none were what they had long transmitted and studied—for this reason the work could not be thorough.
translations.idiomatic: This is because the officials previously dispatched were mostly specialists in single classics—some versed in the Spring and Autumn Annals had not studied the Book of Rites, and some versed in the Book of Changes did not understand the Book of Documents; as for citing other classics and histories in passing, none were subjects they had long transmitted and studied—for this reason the work could not be thorough.

sentences.zh: 伏見國子博士杜鎬、直講崔頤正、孫奭皆苦心強學，博貫《九經》，問義質疑，有所依據。

translations.literal: I respectfully observe that Doctors of the Imperial University Du Hao, Lecturers Cui Yizheng and Sun Shi all study with painful diligence, broadly mastering the Nine Classics; in questioning meaning and raising doubts, they have grounds to rely upon.
translations.idiomatic: I respectfully observe that doctors of the Imperial University Du Hao and lecturers Cui Yizheng and Sun Shi all study with painful diligence and broadly master the Nine Classics; in questioning meaning and raising doubts, they have grounds to rely upon.

sentences.zh: 望令重加刊正，冀除舛謬。

translations.literal: I hope they may be ordered to revise again, in the hope of removing errors and mistakes.
translations.idiomatic: I hope they may be ordered to revise again in the hope of removing errors and mistakes.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 咸平初，又有學究劉可名言諸經版本多舛誤，真宗命擇官詳正，因訪達經義者，至方參知政事，以頤正對。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xianping, there was also a classicist Liu Keming who stated that the various editions of the classics contained many errors; Emperor Zhenzong ordered officials chosen to examine and correct them in detail, and in seeking those who had attained the meaning of the classics, when he reached Vice Grand Councillor Fang, Yizheng was presented in response.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Xianping, there was also a classicist Liu Keming who stated that the various editions of the classics contained many errors; Emperor Zhenzong ordered officials chosen to examine and correct them in detail, and in seeking those who had attained the meaning of the classics, when he reached Vice Grand Councillor Fang, Yizheng was presented in response.

sentences.zh: 曰：「朕宮中無事，樂聞講誦。

translations.literal: He said: "Within the palace I have no affairs and delight in hearing lectures and recitations."
translations.idiomatic: He said: "Within the palace I have no affairs and delight in hearing lectures and recitations."

sentences.zh: 」翌日，召頤正於苑中，說《尚書·大禹謨》，賜以牙緋。

translations.literal: The next day he summoned Yizheng in the garden palace and had him expound the Dayu Mo chapter of the Book of Documents, granting him ivory tally and purple.
translations.idiomatic: The next day he summoned Yizheng in the garden palace and had him expound the Dayu Mo chapter of the Book of Documents, granting him ivory tally and purple robes.

sentences.zh: 自是日令赴御書院待對，說《尚書》至十卷。

translations.literal: From then on he was daily ordered to go to the Imperial Calligraphy Academy to await audience and expound the Book of Documents up to ten scrolls.
translations.idiomatic: From then on he was daily ordered to go to the Imperial Calligraphy Academy to await audience and expound the Book of Documents up to ten scrolls.

sentences.zh: 頤正年老步趨艱蹇，表求致仕，上命坐，問恤甚至，賜器幣，聽以本官致仕，仍充直講，改國子博士。

translations.literal: Yizheng was old and his gait was difficult; he submitted a memorial requesting retirement; the Emperor ordered him seated and questioned him with great solicitude, granted him vessels and silks, permitted him to retire with his existing rank while still serving as lecturer on duty, and changed him to Doctor of the Imperial University.
translations.idiomatic: Yizheng was old and his gait was difficult; he submitted a memorial requesting retirement. The emperor ordered him seated and questioned him with great solicitude, granted him vessels and silks, permitted him to retire with his existing rank while still serving as lecturer on duty, and changed him to doctor of the Imperial University.

sentences.zh: 三年，卒，年七十九。

translations.literal: In the third year he died, aged seventy-nine.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Xianping 3, aged seventy-nine.

sentences.zh: 偓佺，淳化中曆福州連江尉，判國子監李至奏為直講，引對便坐，太宗顧謂曰：「李覺嘗奏朕雲，『四皓』中一先生，或言姓『用』字加撇，或云加點。

translations.literal: Woquan, during Chunhua successively served as assistant magistrate of Lianjiang in Fu Prefecture; Li Zhi, concurrent administrator of the Directorate of the Imperial University, memorialized to make him lecturer on duty; summoned for audience at the informal seat, the Taizong turned and said to him: "Li Jue once memorialized Us saying that among the 'Four White-Haired Recluses,' one elder's surname was written with the character 'yong' plus a slanting stroke, or some say plus a dot."
translations.idiomatic: Woquan during Chunhua successively served as assistant magistrate of Lianjiang in Fu Prefecture; Li Zhi, concurrent administrator of the Directorate of the Imperial University, memorialized to make him lecturer on duty. Summoned for audience at the informal seat, the Taizong turned and said to him: "Li Jue once memorialized me saying that among the 'Four White-Haired Recluses,' one elder's surname was written with the character yong plus a slanting stroke, or some say plus a dot."

sentences.zh: 爾知否？

translations.literal: Do you know or not?"
translations.idiomatic: Do you know which it is?"

sentences.zh: 」偓牷曰：「昔秦時程邈撰隸書，訓如仆隸之易使也。

translations.literal: Woquan said: "In former times in Qin, Cheng Miao composed clerical script, glossed as easy to employ like a servant."
translations.idiomatic: Woquan said: "In former times in Qin, Cheng Miao composed clerical script, glossed as easy to employ like a servant."

sentences.zh: 今字與古或異。

translations.literal: Today's characters and ancient ones sometimes differ.
translations.idiomatic: Today's characters and ancient ones sometimes differ.

sentences.zh: 臣聞刀用為角

translations.literal: Your servant has heard that with dao and yong it becomes jiao
translations.idiomatic: Your servant has heard that with dao and yong it becomes jiao

translations.literal: (pronounced que)
translations.idiomatic: (pronounced que)

translations.idiomatic: , with two dots it is lu.

translations.idiomatic: (pronounced lu)
